_note: Values quoted from the surveyed papers, each with the location it was read from. Nothing here is read off a chart.

pandey2015.source: Pandey et al. 2015, Tables 1-2 and Results (preprint, PDF p. 9)
pandey2015.measure: five-point rating of how much better one quantity is than another; higher means the chart conveys a larger difference

belia2005.measure: p value implied by where respondents placed the second mean so the two means were 'just significantly different'; the correct placement gives p = .05
